# White Peak Partners

> Boutique M&A and capital-raising advisory firm for European technology companies. Sell-side and buy-side M&A, fundraising, secondary placements, dual-track processes and portfolio optimisation, led by former bulge-bracket bankers.

White Peak Partners S.L. advises founders, boards and investors of European technology companies, taking on a small number of mandates at any one time so each is led directly by a partner. The partners spent their early careers at J.P. Morgan, Bank of America, HSBC and BNP Paribas, working on transactions in the hundreds of millions, before building a firm focused on the small- and mid-market — with closer collaboration with founders and investors than a bulge-bracket process allows. Founded 2018.

## Services
- Sell-side M&A
- Buy-side M&A
- Capital raising (Series A, B, growth equity and strategic capital)
- Secondary placements (founder and LP secondaries, tender offers)
- Dual-track processes (parallel sale and fundraise)
- Portfolio optimisation, carve-outs and divestitures

## Sectors
- B2B SaaS
- Vertical & applied AI
- Climatetech
- Deeptech
- Fintech & insurtech
- Marketplace & platforms

## Offices
- London, United Kingdom
- Barcelona, Spain (registered entity: White Peak Partners S.L.)

## Track record
- Open Cosmos — $50m Series B (Sep 2022)
- Carto — financing round above $80m
- Addvolt — cross-border sale to Carrier Global (May 2025)
- Incapto — €10m round led by McWin Capital Partners
- Nearby Computing — €6.5m Series A (2023)
- Walmeric — sale to Globant
- GTMotive — sale to Allianz X

Team members have also advised on landmark transactions earlier in their careers at bulge-bracket banks, including GVT (€7.5bn) and Jazztel (€3.4bn).

## FAQ
Q: How is a boutique M&A advisor different from a bulge-bracket bank?
A: A boutique M&A advisor offers senior, conflict-free attention on a small number of mandates, with partners directly involved throughout, whereas a bulge-bracket bank typically runs a larger volume of transactions with more junior day-to-day staffing. White Peak Partners pairs bulge-bracket experience with boutique focus.

Q: What is a dual-track process?
A: A dual-track process runs a company sale and a fundraising (or IPO) in parallel, keeping both options open until the point a decision must be made. It preserves optionality and can improve terms by maintaining competitive tension between routes.
